error[ZBX-E0555]: the registry refused a blob upload
  while  pushing an image
  cause  registry.test refused closing the upload for blob sha256:645cd3b3d2bb:
         it answered 400
  host   registry.test
  status 400
  code   DIGEST_INVALID
  blob   sha256:645cd3b3d2bb94cb957d9ad8eda4e24bc13ebc28ef39b1a40dd2174763f099ca
  fix    run the same command again; what the registry already holds is not sent twice
  more   zbx explain E0555
